faq.a11: Yes. With Quality checklists you inspect each piece of work item by item, with photos, record any non-conformance with a corrective action and re-inspection, and sign off the work. On your phone it works even with no signal: what you record syncs when you're back online. On the free plan, you can start 3 checklists in total with the 27 ready-made templates, so you can try it out; on PRO, checklists are unlimited and you can create your company's own templates. The ready-made templates are examples to review and adapt: they don't replace the qualified professional responsible for the works, and they don't certify compliance with any standard or quality programme.

indice.metaTitulo: Free quality checklists & site diary templates
indice.metaDescricao: 27 free quality inspection checklist templates and a site diary template to download as PDF and print. The same ones as in the ObraFácil app.
indice.texto: The 27 quality checklists and the site diary, with the same items as the ObraFácil app. Read them here, download the PDF and print it to use on paper. No sign-up needed.
indice.diarioTexto: Date, weather, workforce on site, work done, incidents, photos and the sign-off of the person responsible, with the same fields as the app's site diary.

checklist.paraQue: This template tells you what to inspect on the works at three points: before starting, during the work and at completion. Each item is marked Pass, Fail or N/A. Anything that fails becomes a non-conformance, with a corrective action and reinspection, until the work is approved.

diario.metaDescricao: Free site diary template with weather, workforce, work done, incidents, photos and sign-off. Download the PDF or fill it in on the ObraFácil app.
diario.paraQue: A site diary records the day on site: the weather, who worked, what got done, what happened and the photos, signed off by the person responsible. This template has the same fields as the ObraFácil site diary.

campos.data: The diary date and the project's client.
campos.atividades: What got done that day, trade by trade.

diario: Download the PDF and print one sheet for each day on site.
Fill in the date, client and progress, and tick the day's weather.
List the workforce on site with each person's role, hours and attendance, plus any casual labour.
Write down the work done and the incidents, and number the day's photos.
At the end of the day, the person responsible signs it off.
checklist: Download the PDF and print one sheet for each type of work and each location you inspect.
Fill in the project, location, stage, inspection date and who inspected.
On each item, tick Pass, Fail or N/A, and note what you saw.
For anything that fails, write what was wrong, the corrective action, who it's assigned to and the due date. Then record the reinspection.
Once the work has been checked, mark the approval and sign.
Pass, Fail or N/A on every item, with a photo taken on the spot
Non-conformances with a corrective action, assignee, due date and reinspection
Approval with a signature and the inspection PDF ready to send
Your client sees the approved checklists you share with them in the project portal
Works offline on site: what you record syncs when you're back online
